columns.label: Now
columns.description: In active development — shipping in weeks, not quarters.

columns.label: Next
columns.description: Scoped and queued — the order still moves with your votes.

columns.label: Later
columns.description: Direction agreed, timing open. Loud interest pulls things left.

items.title: Recurring invoices
items.description: Set an invoice to repeat weekly, monthly, or per quarter and Ledgerline drafts and sends it for you — with pause, skip-one, and end-date controls so retainers don't need a calendar reminder.

items.title: Client portal
items.description: A private link where each client sees every invoice you've sent them, downloads PDFs, and checks what's outstanding — no more "can you resend that?" emails in week three.

items.title: Receipt scanning on mobile
items.description: Photograph a receipt and Ledgerline reads the merchant, date, amount, and tax into a draft expense — so the shoebox of paper slips stops being a January problem.

items.title: Multi-currency billing
items.description: Invoice clients in their currency with a daily reference rate, while your dashboard and reports stay in your base currency. Rate and conversion date printed on the invoice.

items.title: Late-payment nudges
items.description: Polite, automatic reminders on a schedule you set — friendly at day 3, firmer at day 14 — with optional late-fee lines calculated from your invoice terms.

items.title: Year-end tax pack
items.description: One export with everything your accountant asks for: income summary, tax collected, deductible expenses by category, and every receipt attached — zipped and labelled.

items.title: Public API and webhooks
items.description: Read and write invoices, clients, and expenses from your own scripts, with signed webhooks for paid, overdue, and refunded events — build the automation we haven't.

items.title: Team seats
items.description: Invite a bookkeeper or a second pair of hands with their own login and a role that fits — full access, expenses-only, or read-only for tax season.
